entries.notes: Product decision: actions are never run late — direct when called or not at all — so a missed press is counted and audited, not executed. HA reports only the LAST run, so a burst during downtime counts as at least one press (the audit says so). A press the home itself refused (outside the window) is audited without taking a use, and a link with no watermark (issued before it was recorded) adopts the home's value instead of counting a press that may already be accounted for.
